question.text: The portfolio manager acts in a ______ capacity with regard to client funds.

explanation.text: The Logic: Fiduciary capacity is explicitly mandated by SEBI (PM) Regs 2020. The Trap: Other terms do not fit legal duty. Cross-Exam Context: Same duty in III-A, X-A. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Document fiduciary standards in the Code of Conduct for internal training.
